alerts.title: Fast REPL Validation
alerts.body: Test custom compiler additions in isolation by linking with `zjs` rather than compiling the entire ZCC toolchain. Execute `./zjs` to run the JS engine with direct bindings to the compiler parser logic.

alerts.title: Interactive GDB Watchpoints
alerts.body: When tracking down mysterious memory mutations in the preprocessor's token stream, use GDB watchpoints on the target pointer address rather than conditional breakpoints to avoid slowing down execution.

alerts.title: Optimizing D3 Network Sim Tick Rates
alerts.body: For large capability graphs in html_corpus_master_registry.html, set `simulation.alphaTarget(0)` after initial layout translation to allow the browser thread to enter low-energy idle modes.

alerts.title: Extracting Clean JS Snippets
alerts.body: To validate JavaScript in embedded HTML files, write a script to scrape contents between `<script>` tags and run `node --check` to avoid runtime browser console errors.

alerts.title: Fast WSL Mount Path Check
alerts.body: Use `wsl -e sh -c "cd /mnt/g/zccMAIN/zcc && git status"` to check file states directly inside the target environment, bypassing slow Windows disk mount abstractions.

alerts.title: Preserving Stack Register Alignment
alerts.body: When generating assembly for System V AMD64 ABI indirect calls, verify that the `%rsp` stack pointer is aligned to a 16-byte boundary *before* loading call arguments.

alerts.title: Floating Point Parity Testing
alerts.body: Check static evaluation discrepancies by compiling test_phase6_trapdoor_side_effect_abi.c with both ZCC and GCC, and diffing their output bytes.

alerts.title: Safe Macro Delimiter Stripping
alerts.body: Ensure trailing CRLF whitespace characters are stripped from `#include` headers in part0_pp.c to prevent file system lookups from failing under WSL.

alerts.title: Leveraging C-Native SHA-256
alerts.body: When signing artifacts, use the standalone `zcc_sha256_hash` function in `src/zcc_oracle_substrate.c` rather than linking to external libraries to maintain cross-platform hash identity.

alerts.title: Inline WebGL Geometry Auto-Framing
alerts.body: Normalize vertex arrays using a scale factor of `3.0 / bounding_radius` to automatically frame custom 3D models in standard browser frustums.

alerts.title: WebAudio Diagnostic Equalizer
alerts.body: Use the `AnalyserNode` FFT bins to verify the frequencies of generated signals when debugging quantum DNA synthesizers.

alerts.title: Quick Swarm Consent Audits
alerts.body: Query local HTTP entry points concurrently using asynchronous Python libraries to verify WebGL context availability across multiple testing threads.

alerts.title: Resolving Token Fusion
alerts.body: Insert explicit barrier checks inside `pp_peek` to prevent the compiler preprocessor from drawing characters past macro expansion boundaries.

alerts.title: Compiling Standalone Monoliths
alerts.body: When building ZCC stage 3, pass an empty arguments list (`s3_p_args=[]`) to GCC since the compiler source has been concatenated into a single monolith.

alerts.title: Non-Destructive Indirect Call Resolution
alerts.body: Read target function offsets from variables using `args_on_stack * 8 + current_push_offset` to prevent pointer adjustments from stomping surrounding local registers.

alerts.title: Hardening Shader Inputs
alerts.body: Always wrap GLSL exponent functions with `max(0.0, base)` to prevent mathematical undefined behavior (NaN) on GPUs when compiling custom 3D engines.

alerts.title: Dynamic subst buffer allocations
alerts.body: Reallocate string buffer limits dynamically when compiling macro bodies with arguments exceeding 8KB to avoid buffer overflows.

alerts.title: Verifying SQLite Initializers
alerts.body: Validate that the static float calculator evaluates expressions like `1.0f/0.0f` correctly during AST generation to keep global limits aligned with GCC.

alerts.title: Profiling Linear Scan Spills
alerts.body: Set `--emit-exec-record` to record interval spill metrics during register allocation to identify register pressure hotspots.

alerts.title: Mapping Shared Capabilities
alerts.body: Highlight cross-domain technologies in network visualizations to identify codebases that overlap between DeFi protocols and WebAudio synthesizers.

alerts.title: Debugging SIGSEGV in stdout
alerts.body: Ensure standard I/O streams are explicitly registered as 64-bit `void*` pointers in the global symbol scope of `part5.c` to prevent print crashes in stage 2 bootstraps.

alerts.title: Isolating Preprocessor RSS
alerts.body: Measure memory consumption using the `--pp-only` flag to evaluate preprocessor allocations separately from static BSS compiler arrays.

alerts.title: Quick SVGs Extrusion Tests
alerts.body: Execute `python tools/zkaedi_svg_extruder.py` to verify that 2D vector coordinates are mapped correctly into 3D polygon meshes.

alerts.title: Confirming Deterministic Replay
alerts.body: Diff execution ledgers from consecutive compilation passes to verify that no ASLR-dependent addresses leak into the `.zxr` logs.

alerts.title: Diagnostic Logging via Printf
alerts.body: When standard error streams are redirected to `/dev/null` inside testing harnesses, write compiler messages directly to stdout.

alerts.title: Phase 0 Compliance
alerts.body: Complete the Phase 0 forensic chain ingestion protocol before modifying any file in the workspace. Verify that the current branch baseline is green using `make selfhost`.

alerts.title: Surgical Changes Only
alerts.body: Limit edits in `part0_pp.c`, `part3.c`, and `part4.c` to less than 50 lines to prevent regressions in Macro, AST, and Codegen layers.

alerts.title: Exact Gate Reporting
alerts.body: Never claim a validation gate passed without pasting the raw output in the commit body (e.g. `cmp zcc2.s zcc3.s` comparison results).

alerts.title: Header Ingestion Order
alerts.body: Order standard libraries (`stdio.h`, `stdlib.h`, `math.h`) above compiler-specific compatibility headers in custom files to avoid header pollution.

alerts.title: Static Compilation Bounds
alerts.body: Set maximum token limits to 65,536 and coordinate node ranges statically to prevent dynamic memory leaks in compiler test passes.

alerts.title: Inter-op Validation Precedent
alerts.body: Run both forward (ZCC lib + GCC main) and reverse (GCC lib + ZCC main) compilation configurations to confirm SysV AMD64 ABI compliance.

alerts.title: WebGL Context Resilience
alerts.body: Check for `webglcontextlost` events in visualizations to handle browser VRAM exhaustion gracefully without freezing the browser interface.

alerts.title: Target Source Compilation
alerts.body: Compile third-party code (like Lua and SQLite) directly from their source trees with ZCC set as the compiler rather than using pre-preprocessed amalgams.

alerts.title: Ring Buffer Thread Safety
alerts.body: Keep all event logging in `src/zcc_oracle_substrate.c` bounded to a static pre-allocated ring buffer array to preserve thread safety.

alerts.title: Floating-Point Parsing in JS
alerts.body: Add double-precision float parsing support to `zjs.c`'s lexer before exposing phase variables to JavaScript automation scripts.

alerts.title: D3 CDN Availability
alerts.body: Ensure offline fallbacks are configured for D3.js imports in dashboards to guarantee UI rendering works in isolated environments.

alerts.title: Multi-Stage Self-Host Verification
alerts.body: Run a full compiler bootstrap from scratch (`make clean && make selfhost`) when modifying core AST types to update all build stages.

alerts.title: Solidity Boundary Rules
alerts.body: Check CVSS vulnerability metrics and reentrancy flags before executing automated exploit simulations in the EVM visualizer.

alerts.title: Maintaining Git Integrity
alerts.body: Avoid git force-pushes or branch resets without documenting the current reflog snapshot in the session logs.

alerts.title: Classifying Aggregate Returns
alerts.body: Ensure aggregates returning via SysV AMD64 ABI classification rules are correctly assigned to registers rather than default sret pointers.

alerts.title: Empty Line CFG Placeholders
alerts.body: Do not skip empty lines in basic block assembly parsers; treat them as placeholding operations to keep pre- and post-optimization CFG topologies aligned.

alerts.title: Non-Destructive Stack Adjustments
alerts.body: Restore the stack pointer exactly to its original value after indirect calls to prevent frame corruption in nested routines.

alerts.title: Reality Drift Enforcement
alerts.body: Configure the compiler to halt compilation if reality drift metrics in `scratch/divergence_report.json` exceed limits set in the constitution.

alerts.title: Dynamic Scale Bounding
alerts.body: Keep scale factors bounded above zero when mapping PCA coordinates to prevent visualizations from collapsing into a single point.

alerts.title: CSS Overlapping Guards
alerts.body: Avoid CSS declarations that place WebGL canvases over interactive HTML overlays to prevent mouse click events from being blocked.

alerts.title: Bypassing WS telemetry failures
alerts.body: Set fallback routes to log metrics locally when telemetry connections to ports like `8892` fail to prevent the dashboard from locking up.

alerts.title: Standalone SHA Implementation
alerts.body: Write cryptographic hashing loops using pure C math blocks in `zcc_sha256.h` to maintain consistent output across WSL and native Windows.

alerts.title: Preserving docstrings
alerts.body: Retain existing docstrings and licensing comments in source files when applying changes to preserve documentation history.

alerts.title: Direct API tool usage
alerts.body: Use dedicated API tools (like `grep_search` and `view_file`) instead of running complex terminal scripts to keep operations clear.

alerts.title: Confirming Target Re-runs
alerts.body: Run target harnesses (such as the 797-function regression suite) after making changes to the preprocessor or parser to verify no regressions were introduced.

alerts.title: Stack Array Overflow Risk
alerts.body: Declaring macro parameter arrays statically as `char[PP_MAX_PARAMS][1024]` can lead to stack overflows during large macro expansions.

alerts.title: Registry Drift Alerts
alerts.body: Adding files to `h:\agents` without updating the index in `html_corpus_master_registry.html` will cause the Knowledge Drift metric to rise.

alerts.title: Empty String Block Collapsing
alerts.body: Skipping empty string placeholders in peephole assembly parsers causes preceding basic blocks to collapse, mutating the CFG topology.

alerts.title: VRAM Leakage in WebGL Canvas
alerts.body: Re-creating Three.js WebGL contexts inside hot reload loops without disposing of geometries and materials will lead to VRAM memory leaks.

alerts.title: Incorrect Classifications in AMD64 ABI
alerts.body: Failing to classify structures correctly before code generation can cause register values to stomp over memory arguments.

alerts.title: Token Fusion during include propagation

alerts.title: Stale Binary SIGSEGV

alerts.title: Hardcoded Path Failures
alerts.body: Hardcoding mount paths like `/mnt/d/` instead of dynamically detecting WSL path mappings will cause builds to fail on different systems.

alerts.title: Global state collisions
